data.title: PAT SIGNAL DECODER 📡
data.statement:
PAT intercepts corrupted radio transmissions from the ruins.
Each transmission starts with a <<key character>> first, whose ASCII value <<mod 26>> gives the shift [[S]].

Every subsequent character that is a letter (A–Z, a–z) has been shifted forward by [[S]] positions in the alphabet (wrapping around). Non-letter characters are unchanged.

Strip the key character, decode the message, and output the clean transmission.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

PAT intercepts corrupted radio transmissions from the ruins.
Each transmission starts with a key character first, whose ASCII value mod 26 gives the shift S.

Every subsequent character that is a letter (A–Z, a–z) has been shifted forward by S positions in the alphabet (wrapping around). Non-letter characters are unchanged.

Strip the key character, decode the message, and output the clean transmission.
Input
Line 1: An integer N, the number of transmissions.
Next N lines: A string T representing a corrupted transmission.
Output
N lines: The decoded message for each transmission (with the first key character removed).
Constraints
3 ≤ N ≤ 5
2 ≤ length of T ≤ 64
T consists of printable ASCII characters only.
Example
Input
4
5ifmmp
5qbuspm
5Hspvoe Afsp
5Tjmfodf.
Output
hello
patrol
Ground Zero
Silence.
